body.statement: Determine the full-class elbow on the unchanged published class \(\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(n)\): decide whether \(\sup_{n\geq1}D_2(n)<\infty\).  If it is finite, determine the exact constant \(\sup_nD_2(n)\); if it is infinite, determine the sharp growth rate and exhibit a dimension-feasible, generically birational, acyclic indegree-two family attaining the lower rate against every recursive order.  Any candidate family must first have at least \(|D|\) missing bidirected pairs, and must then pass exact Jacobian or birationality and half-trek, instrumental-cutset, and auxiliary-cutset audits.  The analysis may start from the unconditional bound \(D_2(n)\leq U_2(n)\), the exact values \(D_2(1)=1\), \(D_2(2)=2\), \(D_2(3)=3\), and the padded \(K_6\) lower bound \(D_2(n)\geq7\) for \(n\geq6\); the overparameterized family \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\) is excluded as a lower family.
body.justification: The remaining field-level question is the sharp constant-versus-growth elbow on the unchanged rationally identifiable indegree-two class.
body.gap: The effective upper bound and degree-seven seed do not decide whether the supremum over graph sizes is finite.
body.consumer: A solution replaces the crude effective cutoff by the smallest-order uniform schedule.

obligation.what_is_open: Decide whether the sequence \(D_2(n)\) is uniformly bounded; if so compute its sharp constant, and if not construct a dimension-feasible birational indegree-two family and prove a matching rate against all recursive structural and disturbance adjunctions.
obligation.obstruction: The former lower family is generically infinite-to-one and therefore cannot witness the published class. The effective Gröbner bound proves finiteness for each fixed graph size but is doubly exponential in an exponential and gives no information about whether the true supremum over sizes is finite.
obligation.attempted: The old windmill was rejected by its exact parameter-dimension excess. The six-vertex two-triangle system was instead solved exactly, and the cubic graph ideal was combined with effective lexicographic elimination. These routes give a constant lower witness and a total upper schedule but do not decide the elbow.
obligation.partial_result: The unconditional effective result is \(D_2(n)\leq U_2(n)=2\cdot8^{2^{n(n+1)}}\) for every \(n\geq1\).  Exact closure gives \(D_2(1)=1\), \(D_2(2)=2\), and \(D_2(3)=3\).  The exact two-triangle calculation gives \(ID_{K_6}=7\), \(\operatorname{ACcert}(K_6)=0\), and isolated-vertex padding gives \(D_2(n)\geq7\) for every \(n\geq6\).  The old windmills cannot provide a lower bound because \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\notin\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(2\ell)\).
